adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees with a case-sensitive check: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. This allows `John@Example.com` to be added even if `john@example.com` already exists, creating a duplicate `BookingAttendee` row. Since `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` to decide which template to send, the two differently-cased emails can cause the same mailbox to receive multiple notifications. (Also, the blacklist check is not normalized either: `blacklistedGuestEmails` is lowercased but `guest` is not.)
